description: Options used when generating a diagram document from a modeling model. `AutoPlaceElementsWithoutViewNode` (default `false`) is the authoring opt-in: with a view selected, an element WITHOUT a stored view node is auto-placed inside its rendered semantic container (after the label band) or on the root grid instead of being hidden by the view — the default keeps the 2.10.0 visibility-gate projection byte-identical for every other consumer (the MCP diagram tool included).
